core_obligations: Reduce to showing that for an affine V etale over Y the preimage of f(E) in V is constructible (proof lines 5946-5950).
Use quasi-compactness of f to get quasi-compactness of V x_Y X and choose an affine scheme U with a surjective etale morphism U -> V x_Y X (proof lines 5951-5954).
Identify the preimage of f(E) in V with the image under U -> V of the preimage of E in U (proof lines 5955-5957).
Apply the scheme case of Chevalley's theorem to U -> V and conclude (proof lines 5958-5959).
difficulty_reason: Counts the author Theorem (named 'Chevalley's Theorem'): for a quasi-compact and locally of finite presentation morphism f : X -> Y of algebraic spaces over S, the image of every etale locally constructible subset of |X| is etale locally constructible in |Y| (source lines 5936-5943). The proof reduces to the scheme case: given E and an affine V etale over Y, one only has to show that the preimage of f(E) in V is constructible; quasi-compactness of f makes V x_Y X quasi-compact, an affine etale U -> V x_Y X then identifies the preimage of f(E) in V with the image under U -> V of the preimage of E in U, and the scheme case of Chevalley's theorem applies to U -> V.
